lead: Cinematic cyberpunk film still at night, industrial megastructure, electric violet and chrome.
notes: Mood-only mini images for cyberdungeon.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen cyberdungeon-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish cyberdungeon-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: cyberdungeon
images.prompt: A vast industrial complex of steel pipes, walkways and tall towers fading into violet fog.

images.name: rider
images.prompt: A chrome android rider standing beside a sleek motorbike under a violet streetlight.

images.name: ghost
images.prompt: A flickering translucent ghostly rider on a motorbike, made of glitching violet light.

images.name: course
images.prompt: A motorbike jumping over a rocky hill crest at night, factory lights in the distance.

images.name: region
images.prompt: A sprawling industrial installation across dark hills, a glowing reactor dome in its center.

images.name: map
images.prompt: A night city seen from above, whole districts going dark one after another.

images.name: break

images.name: lean
